headline: Stlican Shelf Swings Colonial as Weathered Expanse Front Rekindles
war_summary: Three hours have turned the map's temper. The Weathered Expanse, dormant at our last posting, has burst back into base warfare — six exchanges in the past two hours, the latest logged as this edition went to press, with Crow's Nest and Frostmarch the busiest posts and the ground there divided six Colonials to three Wardens. Stlican Shelf has swung Colonial: fighting about Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House ran to the cutoff hour, and five posts now fly Colonial colors against three Warden, one base lying in ruins between the lines. On the Mooring front the grind rolls on undecided — seven actions in two hours around Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut, the nine-to-three Warden lead standing as it was. Farranac Coast, ablaze at our last report, has fallen silent since mid-afternoon; Stonecradle keeps the quiet it began at mid-morning. The casualty ledgers climb fastest where no base event stirs: Callahan's Passage counted better than twenty-five hundred fallen in two hours without a single post changing hands, and the Nevish Line and Dead Lands trace the same steepening curve. It is the 362nd day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
